answer: One workable design: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because vertex only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, quartz is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any cedar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
